deprecationEvidence.announcement: 2024-01-17 SiloDAO post 'A plan to deprecate XAI Stablecoin' (author ayham.eth, Silo admin): XAI failed to scale DEX liquidity and hovered below peg; plan to retract XAI credit lines and direct deposits, burn credit lines, deprecate the XAI module so no more XAI can be minted, and cut Curve XAI/FRAXBP incentives by end of February 2024

deprecationEvidence.priorOracleReview: Coin-file oracleRisk.branchApplicability (reviewed 2026-07-21): SiloDAO's deprecation plan retracted XAI credit lines and deprecated the mint module; no current production XAI branch exists and the legacy branch cannot be reconstructed completely from public evidence

collateralizationRatio.rationale: The XAI mint module was deprecated by SiloDAO governance in 2024 and credit lines were burned; the residual 5,358,653.23 XAI supply at block 25627256 is wind-down remnant (un-repaid legacy borrows and stranded liquidity), not a live CDP system. A collateralization ratio measured over the residual debt of a deprecated module would not describe a functioning mechanism and is not measurable against any current documented branch inventory.

liquidationCapacityRatio.rationale: No current production XAI liquidation branch exists to measure; the legacy silo inventory was progressively retracted and burned per the 2024-04-22 governance execution post, and Silo publishes no post-deprecation accounting of remaining XAI debt, collateral, or bad-debt treatment.
